newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Australia to close Sydney plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Australia to close Sydney plant.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it would close its remaining manufacturing operations at the Rhodes plant in Sydney which make phthalic anhydride and plasticisers.
The company said 60 jobs would be lost.
ICI said the latest move follows its 1992 closure of six plants at the Rhodes site.
The company said it was the only Australian manufacturer of phthalic anhydride and plasticisers, which were used in the paint, polyester resin, cabling, textile and automotive industries.
"Unfortunately we can no longer maintain commercial viability given the scale of our operation and continued reduction in tariffs," executive director Philip Weickhardt said.
ICI is a unit of Imperical Chemical Industries Plc.
He said the plants had achieved productivity improvements and experienced an upturn in global markets in recent years.
"However, prices in Australia are now at an historical low due to further tariff reductions, low international prices and significant dumping of product from overseas," Weickhardt.
ICI said the local market would be supplied from imports.
